objective: join a Nigerian skincare price-friction post with a serious principle of visible, comparable prices before checkout

sourcePost.observedText: Just stocked up on my tretiheal cream. I was able to get 3 packs because the price was literally half of the price that I last got it. I am pleased and angry at the same time. Why do people over price their goods? The first time I got tretiheal cream, I got it for 3,500 naira. Fast forward 2 years after, the only place I knew of that had it sold it at 10k. About 2 weeks ago, I Googled tretiheal and saw a skincare shop/website selling it for 5,160 naira.
